tests.name: test_ac1_add_with_due_stores_the_date_and_without_stores_no_key
tests.scenario: add with --due stores due string and prints added 1; add without stores no due key.

tests.name: test_ac1_add_task_with_due_sets_the_due_key_only_when_given
tests.scenario: core.add_task with due sets key; without leaves it out.

tests.name: test_ac2_add_with_a_bad_due_is_an_error_and_changes_nothing
tests.scenario: Six bad values: exit 2, exact stderr, empty stdout, file unchanged or still absent.

tests.name: test_ac2_add_task_rejects_a_bad_due_and_leaves_tasks_alone
tests.scenario: core.add_task raises ValueError for bad due and does not append.

tests.name: test_ac2_parse_date_is_strict_and_accepts_a_leap_day
tests.scenario: parse_date accepts leap day, raises ValueError on loose forms.

tests.name: test_ac3_list_shows_the_due_date_of_dated_tasks
tests.scenario: list and list --all print (due DATE) suffix exactly, none for undated.

tests.name: test_ac4_list_overdue_shows_open_past_due_tasks_ordered
tests.scenario: list --overdue with TASKLIST_TODAY: order 2,7,1; --all same; empty when nothing overdue.

tests.name: test_ac4_ac5_overdue_tasks_filters_and_orders_by_explicit_today
tests.scenario: core.overdue_tasks with explicit dates filters, excludes today, orders by (due,id).

tests.name: test_ac5_today_comes_from_the_environment_and_a_bad_value_is_an_error
tests.scenario: TASKLIST_TODAY changes --overdue output; bad value exits 2 with error line; plain list unaffected.

tests.name: test_ac6_a_010_file_keeps_working_and_done_adds_no_due_key
tests.scenario: Undated 0.1.0 file: list, --all, --overdue (empty), done leaves no due key.

stub_check.detail: uv run --no-project --with pytest pytest -q -o pythonpath=tests/_stubs: 21 failed all on assertions, 17 existing passed; the plain command still imports the real tasklist (21 failed there too, on the missing feature); stubs removed after the build.
